comment: Declared before any comparison was computed (2026-11-21). The record carries this file's sha256. Ranges are kinetic energies in MeV; a criterion is the largest |kernel / table - 1| over the range.

pdg_ionization.kernel: eloss.dedx_restricted(p, tcut=inf); eloss_jax in float32 and float64
pdg_ionization.note: the kernel omits shell, higher-order and radiative corrections by design (its docstring: below 1 % for 0.1-100 GeV); outside the range reported only

pdg_photonuc.note: Geant4's G4KokoulinMuonNuclearXS and the PDG tables' photonuclear parametrisation differ by design

material_match: a material whose hep-simkernels density or I differs from the table's by more than 1 % is reported without a pass line for the collision and ionization rows (density effect)
